transcript: Jack Wolfe made his Broadway debut in Hadestown last night and I was floored his Orpheus was very different the choices were so unique and so brilliant and also like very Jack Wolfe first off we all know he has the most insane voice ever like it's so beautiful he sings with so much yearning and heart there are a lot of clips out there I'll throw a clip at the end of the video so people who don't wanna hear him won't get spoiled but the thing that really surprised me is I've never seen an Orpheus that was so physical and what I mean by that is the way that Jack used his body to physically express the way Orpheus was feeling his Orpheus is petrified this is a boy that the second he sees the fates is horrified and scared of them spent so much of the first act hunched scared of the world and he is this sweet sensitive poet boy as he falls in love with eurydice and as she returns that love you watch him kind of unfurl and stand tall and be brave and find his voice and then Persephone goes away he immediately starts to curl back into himself as he begins to finish his song and he realises that Eurydice is gone you watch him lose himself he is so scared to follow her he is so scared but he's like I'm going to do this she is worth this even though I am afraid and he really used his body to tell that story in a way that I just have not seen another Orpheus do and for me the biggest moment the most incredible wonderful moment was during the wait for me reprise where he says goodbye to Eurydice he says goodbye to Hades and you watch him like start to crumble and then you watch him go like no you can do this you can do this and he starts to stand and then we get doubt comes in and you watch him just slowly lose all of that confidence to the point that when he turns around it feels inevitable like he knew it was coming like he always knew it was coming apparently there was like a tweet going around saying that Jack's Orpheus is an Orpheus who remembers that he's done this before and I think there is a lot of truth in that because he wants to be brave just so badly and he just can't absolutely broke my heart another really good example of this is he starts if it's true literally curled up on the ground and he's just been beaten up and he's bloody and he starts singing just in a the fetal position he's just so desperate in that song to be heard and to be seen and for his voice to matter totally different interpretation than I've seen before and the moment that killed me where he turn turned around and he realised what he had done he runs towards where she was and he reaches his hand down into the like the hole and I was like there's just so many incredible choices that he made and this was night one I'm gonna go back in like a month and the whole thing's gonna feel different and special and totally unique but you just you have to go see Jack Wolfe
